$comment: Generated from proto/mailhero/webhook/v1/mail_received.proto by proto/tools/gen_schema.py: do not edit. Self-contained on purpose (no $defs or $ref): Todofy's machine API document refers to it by path, and each consumer reads it without resolving references.
title: Mail Hero mail.received.v1 event
description: Mail Hero mail.received.v1 event: one delivery of one message to the webhook consumer, POSTed with the Idempotency-Key header equal to event_id. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know: optional fields may be added within v1, and a breaking change is a new `type`.

event_id.description: One delivery intent: retries keep it, an owner's resend as a new event gets a new one. Consumers deduplicate by it.

received_at.description: When Mail Hero received the message (UTC).

canary.description: Present only on synthetic end-to-end canary events (contracts/ops-v1). Consumers MUST NOT cause external side effects (tasks, messages, reports) for an event that carries it. An event whose canary is present but unreadable must not cause side effects either: reject it (4xx) or handle it as a canary.

run_id.description: The dashboard's run. Not an identity or an instruction: consumers record canary results by event_id.

message.description: The message, normalized: never raw MIME, HTML, attachment bytes or the SMTP envelope.

id.description: The local message (the raw .eml Mail Hero keeps); every event of the message has the same one.

from.description: The From addresses. External content, never an authenticated identity.

address.description: The address as the header gives it.

name.description: The display name, empty when there is none.

to.description: The To addresses, without Mail Hero's own inbox address.

address.description: The address as the header gives it.

name.description: The display name, empty when there is none.

subject.description: The subject (at most 4 KiB of UTF-8); it or the text is not blank.

sent_at.description: The Date header, null when the message has none that parses.

rfc_message_id.description: The Message-ID header, null when the message has none.

text.description: The normalized plain text (at most 256 KiB of UTF-8, cut at a character boundary when longer).

text_truncated.description: Whether text was cut by the UI's 1 MiB or the webhook's 256 KiB budget: the text is then not the whole source.

original_text_bytes.description: UTF-8 size of normalized plaintext before UI/webhook truncation; not raw MIME size. Present whenever text_truncated, and then larger than the text's size; otherwise, when present, equal to it.

html_omitted.description: HTML over the safe processing budget was left out; usable plain text may still be there.

needs_review.description: Unreadable text or unexpanded MIME: a person must look. Consumers must not guess a body for it.

warnings.description: Safe reason codes for the flags above; [] on every storage-v1 event, absent on older frozen ones.

content_policy_version.description: The content policy the event was built with: storage-v1 today.

attachments_omitted_count.description: Attachment records omitted beyond the 100-record metadata cap. Excludes listed records whose byte copies were omitted.

attachments.description: The first 100 attachments' metadata; bytes never travel in the event.

filename.description: The file name the message gives.

content_type.description: The MIME type the message gives.

storage_status.description: Copy status at event creation, not a promise of perpetual availability.

omitted_reason.description: Why the copy was omitted (with storage_status omitted).
